facts.fact: India's Press Information Bureau says NCGG began the first two-week programme for 29 senior Seychelles civil servants on 11 May 2026, covering digital public infrastructure, AI-enabled governance, e-Courts and digitisation and digital payments, as the first milestone of a three-year NCGG-Public Service Bureau MoU to train 250 civil servants.
